faqs.q: What kinds of events do you manage?
faqs.a: Corporate events, college fests, concerts, brand activations, weddings, private celebrations and more.
For large events we recommend 6–8 weeks. We can also handle shorter timelines.

faqs.q: Do you help colleges find sponsors?
faqs.a: Yes. Sponsorship and brand partnerships for fests are one of our core services.

faqs.q: Can you book celebrities and artists?
faqs.a: Yes. We handle artist booking, negotiation, contracts and hospitality.
